action_summary: Prefer the existing four-fold exp320 PET large experiment with the exact score thresholds associated with v129 (0.82845 versus current 0.80526), preserving its prompt, tokenizer additions, output scaling, equal fold averaging, and strict checkpoint loading. Sort PET batches by length, use batch size 4, load checkpoint tensors through CPU, and align rounded predictions by essay_id in sample-submission order. Retain the original v136 small-model job only when the referenced PET artifacts are absent; that fallback is not expected to improve the score. Run the selected job with checked subprocess execution and validate the final submission schema, IDs, and integer score range. Artifact availability and leaderboard improvement cannot be verified without competition data; no training or inference was run.
